parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource.

Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates that the resource is a bastion host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
